create_codegen_config: create a CodeGenConfig instance with default transformer configuration parameters
initialize_codegen_model: initialize a CodeGenModel with a CodeGenConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the model configuration via model.config attribute
customize_codegen_parameters: customize CodeGenConfig parameters like n_embd, n_layer, n_head, and rotary_dim
map_codegen_attributes: map CodeGenConfig attributes to standard names like hidden_size and num_attention_heads
